propositions: On-demand workflow_dispatch CI job must interrogate pinned amd64 Jira DC image and emit structured environment contract (vocabularies, fields, workflows, limits) as committed data rather than discovering these at test time
Map job output must include raw REST request/response evidence for each claim and remain traceable to that evidence, not to LLM summary
Deployed capability-map answers must be committed as data and asserted before harness tests run; the contract is authored once per image re-pin and consumed deterministically
Image digest pinning must be derived from Dockerfile FROM line at runtime and verified against committed data to prevent stale answers after re-pin

Four rebar vocabulary entries (priorities, issue types, statuses/workflows with transitions, link types and directions) must be validated per instance with accept/reject/present-but-different verdicts
Five hardcoded length limits (summary, label, description, comment, ADF) must be empirically measured at limit-1/limit/limit+1 with read-back verification to detect accept-and-truncate silently
